gloss: to rephrase; to say again; to correct oneself

definitions.gloss: to rephrase; to say again; to correct oneself
definitions.explanation: to say something again in different words, or to correct what one has said

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{間違|まちが}えたので{言|い}い{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I misspoke so I corrected myself.

examples.japanese: もう{一度|いちど}{言|い}い{直|なお}してください。
{分|わ}かりやすく{言|い}い{直|なお}すと、こういうことだ。
examples.english: To put it more simply, this is what it means.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMPOUND VERB:
{言|い}う (to say) + {直|なお}す (to redo/fix)
The {直|なお}す adds the meaning of doing again or correcting.

USAGE:
- {言|い}い{直|なお}してください (please say it again/rephrase it)
- {言|い}い{直|なお}すと (to put it differently)
- {言|い}い{間違|まちが}えを{言|い}い{直|なお}す (to correct a slip of the tongue)

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す (to rewrite)
- {やり直|なお}す (to redo)
- {作|つく}り{直|なお}す (to remake)

RELATED:
- {言|い}い{換|か}える (to rephrase, paraphrase)
- {訂正|ていせい}する (to correct)
- {修正|しゅうせい}する (to revise)
